title: Is Better Worth It? - Yoeleo Gravel Wheels 6 Months Later - SAT C45 DB Pro - Carbon Wheelset Review

takeaways.text: After a summer of UK gravel use the labyrinth-sealed hub bearings and DT-style freehub were clean, spoke tension had not changed, and runout was still about 0.1 mm front and 0.2 mm rear.
Unexpectedly comfortable across several tire models, which the reviewer attributes to the 27 mm internal width; the hole-free sealed rim bed gave no tubeless air-loss problems.

Only bearings and the freehub were listed as spares. An anonymous email to Yoeleo about a lost end cap (24 November) had no reply after about three weeks, while a rival brand answered the same email within an hour with a parts link.

disclosure: Follow-up on the wheels YOELEO supplied for the creator’s earlier review; the description carries affiliate links and a discount code.
summary: Months-later follow-up on the same SAT C45 DB Pro NxT wheels after gravel riding in England. The hub generation is not named.
